copy.step0_goal: Fly to Pumpkin Patch and enter The Silver Trees. Use your Illuminate skill to get some Feathers from Bobbi the Blue Jay . Return to Iridessa's Glade in Sunflower Gully when you are done!
copy.step0_intro_0: Hi, sunshine! You've been practicing your Talent Skills, haven't you? I hope so -- I have a talent job for you!
copy.step0_intro_1: Vidia lets me borrow her palm frond fan every once in a while. It's perfect for blowing light sparkles into sacks to bring to the mainland.
copy.step0_intro_2: Anyway, Vidia only lets me borrow her fan if I give her a Blue Jay Feather. She always needs Feathers -- the fast-flying talents go through them, well, FAST.
copy.step0_intro_3: I'm completely out of Blue Jay Feathers, and I need to use her fan again! Can you go out to The Silver Trees and ask Bobbi the Blue Jay for some Feathers for me?
copy.step0_intro_4: Blue Jays love shiny things, so if you entertain her with some light, I'm sure she'll give you some Feathers!
copy.step0_intro_5: Oh, and I'm sure you'll find Bobbi faster if you take some friends with you!
copy.step0_summary: Iridessa wants you to fly to The Silver Trees and use your Illuminate Talent Skill to get some Feathers from Bobbi the Blue Jay!
